purpose: Teach: 前作/反復/ハードル/ベタ/アンコール/アウトドア/大晦日/ぶどう

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さん、本気で、絶対、好きな映画の、絶対、前作、絶対、見直したわ
lines.en: Sho, I'm serious — I rewatched the prequel to my favorite movie!
lines.style: Bright and immediate, like she's bursting to share news. Quick attack on the opening. Warm energy, pitched forward. Natural speaking rhythm with a lift at the revelation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、漢字、絶対、反復、絶対、練習、絶対、頑張ってるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm really trying hard — I practice my kanji over and over every day.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity with underlying pride. Measured pace, choosing words carefully like he wants her to understand he means it. Small but steady conviction in his voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、お勉強の、絶対、ハードル、絶対、ちょっと、絶対、高めようね
lines.en: Sho, we should bump up your study goals a little bit — you're ready for it.
lines.style: Encouragement wrapped in gentleness. Warm, steady tone. She leans in slightly, not pushing but inviting. Confident in him without being performative about it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんが、本気で、絶対、ベタ、絶対、なギャグ、絶対、言うんだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad keeps making these cheesy jokes — you know what I mean?
lines.style: Dry, observant delivery. Small smile underneath. Conspiratorial tone, like he's sharing a private understanding with her. Slight timing on the complaints, not bitter.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、コンサートで、本気で、絶対、アンコール、絶対、あったわ
lines.en: Sho, there was an encore at the concert — it was wonderful!
lines.style: Delight with a touch of nostalgia. Slightly breathy on the word 'encore' like she's reliving it. Animated but not frantic. The pleasure of having something to tell him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと、本気で、絶対、アウトドア、絶対、行きたいな
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really want to go camping with Dad sometime soon.
lines.style: Hopeful and open. Gentle attack, no urgency but genuine desire. Slight lift at the end like he's testing the idea out loud. Natural, unguarded.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、本気で、絶対、大晦日、絶対、お家で、絶対、お祝いしようね
lines.en: Sho, let's celebrate New Year's Eve together at home — just us.
lines.style: Tender resolve, like she's making a quiet promise. Even pace, warm but grounded. The words land softly. She means every word.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、本気で、絶対、ぶどう、絶対、ジュース、絶対、好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really like grape juice — it's my favorite!
lines.style: Simple, genuine enthusiasm. Unfiltered joy in how he says it. No irony, no hedging. The honesty of a child sharing something he loves with someone he trusts.
